paragraphs.text: Connects DeepSeek Harness to your own Recued server over MCP.
# dsh-recued

Connects DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) to your own
Recued server.

Recued is a server you run on a computer you control. It keeps your notes, tasks, mail, calendar
and

the things you own, and it stands between your data and any AI: it checks every request
against wha
t you granted, asks you before a change, and keeps a record of what was done.

This plugin adds one row of DeepSeek Harness's own MCP client (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`),
point

ed at your Recued server. It ships no code of its own; the whole plugin is
`cordis.patch.yml`.
## What you need

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2 (tested with 0.2.1-rc.2), with `pnpm` on your `PATH` for `dsh plugin`.
- A Re

cued server: install it on a computer you
control.
- A contract for DeepSeek Harness. In the Recued

web app, open Contracts, make a contract, choose
the tools DeepSeek Harness may use, and copy the ke

ontracts, make a contract, choose
the tools DeepSeek Harness may use, and copy the key Recued shows.
## Install

That installs it into the Web UI's profile. For a headless run, use `--profile headless`; for
anothe
r profile, its name.
Then put the contract's key in `~/.dsh/.env` (or `$DSH_HOME/.env` if you set `DSH_HOME`):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
If Recued runs on another computer, add the address the contract's Connect tab shows:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Without `RECUED_MCP_URL`, the plugin connects to `http://127.0.0.1:7717/mcp`, the Recued server on
t
his computer. Without `RECUED_MCP_TOKEN`, the plugin stays off.

Restart DeepSeek Harness (`dsh web`). Recued's tools appear as `mcp__recued__<tool>`; DeepSeek
Harne

ss may add a short suffix to a name, as in `mcp__recued__work_search_71e96de3b41a`. To check,
ask: "
Which notes do I have in Recued?"
## How it works

- The tools you see are the ones the contract grants. To give DeepSeek Harness another tool,
change

the contract in the Recued web app.
- Reading runs at once.
- A change waits for you. Recued answers

`awaiting_approval` and tells the agent to have you
approve it in the Recued app, from the bell at

the top of the page. When you have answered, tell
the agent, and it can ask Recued for the result.
-

DeepSeek Harness does not ask before it calls a Recued tool. What a tool may do is decided in
Recue
d, by the contract and your approvals.
## Privacy

Your data stays on your Recued server. The model sees only what a tool returns, and Recued
returns o

nly what the contract grants. The key stays in your `.env` file; it is not written into
the plugin o

ntract grants. The key stays in your `.env` file; it is not written into
the plugin or your profile.
